items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I believe Baby Dodd studied under him for a time. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that was one time. I probably, I know a lot of musicians were responsible and got their training for them.

ctx.x: Very light. He played in brass band. He played sousie bone. Sometimes he played trombone and maybe baritone. Yeah.
I believe Baby Dodd studied under him for a time.

Well, that was one time. I probably, I know a lot of musicians were responsible and got their training for them. Yeah. Maybe they didn't stay long, but if they didn't get their training, they'd come down there and borrow instruments, you know. Yeah.
